fields.description: First word of the 8-byte EEPROM save header, ASCII 'shrk' (Shrek). Written to EEPROM block 0 on first boot and bulk-loaded with the rest of the save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08013f78 writes the default 8-byte header from DAT_08013fe0 to EEPROM address 0 via FUN_0801bbb4; FUN_08013edc loads EEPROM block 0 into the RAM save buffer at DAT_08013f08 via FUN_0801b9c0; baseline logical bytes 0..3 are 'shrk'.
fields.name: save_tag_prefix

fields.description: Second word of the 8-byte EEPROM save header, ASCII 'kart'. This is the word the loader validates against the ROM constant; a mismatch forces a re-initialization of block 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08013edc compares save-buffer bytes 4..7 against the ROM constant at DAT_08013f50 and returns status 2 on mismatch, which makes FUN_08013f78 rewrite block 0 via FUN_0801bbb4; baseline logical bytes 4..7 are 'kart'.
fields.name: save_tag_suffix

fields.description: First little-endian word of the 448-byte save payload (EEPROM blocks 1..56). Per-field game semantics are not exposed by this decomp slice; exposed as a mutable scalar probe for live testing. Baseline reads erased (0xFFFFFFFF).
fields.evidence: FUN_08013edc bulk-loads 0x39 blocks of 8 bytes via FUN_0801b9c0 into the buffer at DAT_08013f08, and FUN_08013f78 bulk-copies 0x1c0 payload bytes; save-file offset 8 is the first payload word past the 8-byte header.
fields.name: payload_u32_0

fields.description: Second little-endian word of the 448-byte save payload. Same provenance as payload_u32_0; exposed as a second mutable scalar probe for live testing. Baseline reads erased (0xFFFFFFFF).
fields.evidence: FUN_08013edc bulk-loads 0x39 blocks of 8 bytes via FUN_0801b9c0 into the buffer at DAT_08013f08, and FUN_08013f78 bulk-copies 0x1c0 payload bytes; save-file offset 12 is the second payload word past the 8-byte header.
fields.name: payload_u32_1

fields.description: Remainder of the 448-byte save payload (EEPROM blocks 2..56). Covered by the same bulk load/copy as the payload head; entirely erased (0xFF) in the baseline capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_08013edc reads EEPROM blocks 0..0x38 via FUN_0801b9c0 and FUN_08013f78 copies 0x1c0 payload bytes; save-file offsets 16..456 are blocks 2..56, all 0xFF in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: payload_rest

fields.description: EEPROM blocks 57..63, past the loader's 0x39-block bound, so never read or written by the save routines. Entirely erased (0xFF) in the baseline capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_08013edc loop bound uVar3 < 0x39 proves blocks 57..63 are never loaded; save-file offsets 456..512 are all 0xFF in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: trailing_unused

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'shrkkart' (Shrek Kart) 8-byte save header at EEPROM block 0, logical domain
